method: loose screen (any money value in a bounded retrieval answer reappearing in chat within 21d) -> full hand-labelled census of all 109 distinct unflagged values; no sampling
screen_ceiling: money values repeated verbatim only; other quantities and paraphrased numbers are invisible to screen and detector alike

cause: a bare month/year label was treated as a preserved bound
repair-language filter scanned the whole message

fixes: bound preservation requires a day-level reference or explicit bounding phrase
repair language only within 240 chars of the value
completed outcomes excluded on the origin side
